items.question: How much can I actually save with Union National Tax?
items.answer: Every business is different. Potential savings depend on your entity structure, eligibility, and the strategies you implement. During a strategy call, we review your current setup and numbers to identify planning opportunities and recommend next steps that fit your business.

items.question: What if I'm already working with a CPA?
items.answer: We can work alongside your existing CPA, adding tax planning, construction-specific guidance, and support throughout the year.

items.question: What formats are available?
items.answer: Available formats vary by book. Check the format list and edition options before choosing. The Retirement book’s formats still need confirmation.

items.question: Which book should I start with?
items.answer: Choose a book around your goal: tax planning, financial visibility, business growth, or retirement.

items.question: Are the strategies IRS-compliant?
items.answer: These books provide educational guidance; a strategy’s suitability depends on your circumstances and applicable rules. Discuss implementation with a qualified tax professional rather than treating a book as a guarantee of IRS compliance.

items.question: How will I receive my order?
items.answer: Confirm digital access and any physical delivery arrangements with our team before ordering; timing depends on the book and format.

items.question: What are the refund terms?
items.answer: Contact our team before ordering to confirm the refund terms for your chosen book and format.

ClientInsight.title: From reactive filing to a year-round plan.
ClientInsight.introduction: Torres Built Construction worked with Union National Tax on an S-Corp strategy and proactive quarterly planning. The client’s experience shows how that approach brought more clarity to tax decisions and what deserves attention next.
ClientInsight.challengeBody: Reactive tax filing, an unclear entity structure, and limited planning visibility.
ClientInsight.assessmentBody: An S-Corp evaluation and defined tax priorities formed the strategy for the business.
ClientInsight.planningBody: Proactive quarterly planning brought the tax conversation into a year-round cadence, with defined next steps.
ClientInsight.outcomeBody: Clearer tax decisions and a defined path to reduce avoidable burden.
